title: Binary base point of a DNF term
statement: Let $T$ be a DNF term on $n$ coordinates, with distinct literal indices, and let its support be the set of indices appearing in its literals. Define a point of the binary cube by assigning to each coordinate in the support the binary value corresponding to its required sign, and assigning $0$ to every coordinate outside the support.
hypotheses_covered: The term is a finite list of literals on $n$ coordinates
Literal indices in the term are pairwise distinct
